sample_unit: participants (1181 maternity service users and 112 healthcare professionals)
unlisted_practices: Mixed-methods implementation feasibility study (NASSS framework) of a clinical decision support tool before a cluster RCT
Local champions, multidisciplinary buy-in, and dedicated resources to support implementation
Mitigating double data entry and optimising IT infrastructure
Ensuring the tool guides care for all users, including pregnant users who cannot or choose not to engage with it

screen.reason: Evaluated the feasibility and implementation barriers/facilitators of deploying a clinical decision support tool for preterm birth and placental dysfunction risk across four NHS maternity services, but did not compare outcomes with vs. without a specific deployment safeguard/practice.
